bio.text: Rebecca Bennett is the Democratic candidate for New Jersey's 7th Congressional District, where Republican Tom Kean Jr. is the incumbent.
Bennett, 39, lives in Bridgewater with her husband and two children; she was born in New York and grew up in Texas.
She served in the military for 15 years, including as a helicopter pilot and experimental test pilot, and earned an MBA from the Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania.
She has since worked at digital health, health care technology and pharmaceutical companies.
